name: jwt decode
description: Decode a JWT token and output header, payload, and signature as JSON

name: deps scan
description: Inventory all dependencies from manifest files (local only, no network)

name: deps diff
description: Show dependency changes between two git refs (local only, no network)

name: encode
description: Encode or decode base64, base64url, hex or URL text, or hash a file, and check the result

name: cert
description: Decode certificates (PEM or DER, one or a chain) and check the chain order, signatures, validity and an optional host (local only, no network)

name: semver compare
description: Compare two versions and name the part they differ in (local only, no network)

name: semver satisfies
description: Check whether a version satisfies a range (local only, no network)

name: semver sort
description: Sort versions, and find the highest that satisfies a range (local only, no network)

name: semver bump
description: Bump a version: the next major, minor, patch or prerelease (local only, no network)
